description.public:
Weapon Kit · Engineer invention. Counts as a weapon for swapping and stowing. Toolbelt options cost 2 Actions and 1 Toolbelt scrap.

Considered a mace.

Strike (basic) — 1 Action. Reach 1, 2d6+STR Lightning. You have advantage if you are Charged. On crit: gain Charged.

Toolbelt (2 Actions, 1 scrap):

  • System Shock. Reach 1, 2d6+STR Lightning, lose Charged. If you lost Charged, target must make a STR save or be Stunned. On a save, they are Dazed, 1 turn.
  • Arc Leap. Range 6. Gain Charged. Teleport to a spot in Range, then Burst 1, 2d6. Ignores armor.
  • Discharge. Reach 1, 2d6 Lightning, lose Charged. If you lose Charged, deal damage in Burst 2 instead. Ignores armor; can still crit or miss.

High Levels: +6 damage every 5 levels (Strike, System Shock); +4 damage every 5 levels (Arc Leap, Discharge).

[A] Strike rolls 2d6+STR Lightning (+6 per 5 levels).

[A] Each Toolbelt option is its own "Electro Baton: …" feature granted with the kit; using one spends 1 Toolbelt scrap — tracked on the sheet (click the counter to correct mistakes).

[M] Take advantage while you are Charged; on a crit give yourself Charged.

[M] "Considered a mace" (Scrapper's Applied Force) is not encoded: giving it a weapon type would stop non-Scrapper Engineers from critting with it.
